transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Um, well, student health actually sent me here. They told me my weight is too low to clear me for the youth workshops I want to do. They said the number has kept dropping, but... honestly, to me, it just feels like what happens when I’m really focused and busy with things.
How do you feel about the idea of gaining weight back to where student health wants it to be?

Honestly... the thought of gaining it back makes me panic. Even just the idea of gaining a single pound is too much. Like, if I were to eat a normal dinner, or if I had something with butter in it... I feel like everyone would immediately be able to see that I’ve lost my discipline. So the idea of going back to the weight they want just really scares me.
When you look at yourself in the mirror right now, how does your body look to you?

Um, well, when I look in the mirror, or even at photos... like, the photos from my recent art showcase... I don't really see the artwork first. I just immediately zoom in on my arms and my waist. If I look small enough in those pictures, it makes me feel like I'm serious and put-together. But if I don't, I just feel like I look huge.
